title: Agent activity records
responsibility: Defines the stored registration, heartbeat and completion records, plus the types used to report agents and repository activity.

outputs.name: agentRegistrationSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a version 1 registration: nonempty identity, label and registration time; nullable provider, model and process identity; positive integer heartbeat allowance. Extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentBeatSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a heartbeat with a nonempty time, nullable branch, task and loop, and an array of nonempty unit ids. Extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentEndSchema
outputs.description: Zod schema for a final completion time, completed or failed status, and nullable outcome. Extra fields are rejected.
